decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [0588-100.01-C, BR000.01, BR.000.03, BR.000.04, BR.000.05, BR.000.06, BR-500.02, BR-500.03, BR1-000.02, BR1-100.08-A, BR1-300.07-B, BR1-300.08-A, BR1-300.09-B, BR1-300.11-B, BR1-400.05-A, BR1-500.01-A, Cover letter dated 02/05/2025, Heritage Impact Assessment, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Flood Risk Assessment, AC Cooler Data Sheet and Fire Safety Statement. Received: 13/05/2025
BR1-100.09-C, BR1-100.10-C, BR1-100.11-C, BR1-300.12-C, BR1-300.13-C, BR1-400.04-C and Cover letter dated on 25/11/25. Received: 29/12/2025
BR.000.01. Received: 23/02/2026
].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The basement hereby permitted shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
Reason: In order to ensure that adequate living standards are maintained and to protect neighbours' living conditions.

Condition : 5 - The trees that are specified on the drawings hereby approved to be retained shall be protected before commencement of any works on site and throughout the course of the development by methods that conform to the best practice guidance contained in British Standard BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.

Condition : 6 - The Construction Logistics Plan shall be that approved under application P/2023/3736 on 08/02/2024. The approved Plan shall be adhered to throughout the construction period. 
Reason: To ensure highway safety is maintained and preserved in accordance with Policy EC2 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 7 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public. 
Reason: In order to protect the living conditions of neighbouring residents.
description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to reduce the number of roof windows and alterations to the doors following planning permission P/2025/1515 approved 08/07/2025 Erection of a single storey and part first floor rear extension and a two storey side extension. Creation of a basement with one rear and two front lightwells. Internal and external alterations including works to trees, soft and hard landscaping to both front and rear, cycle, refuse and recycling stores, and installation of replacement windows following the demolition of the existing single storey rear extension and outbuildings.
